# Veritone to Present at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference on September 14, 2026


September 10, 2026 8:00am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_a580c7bd1ba2279c7b7412d2fe7d0495/veritone/news/2026-09-10_Veritone_to_Present_at_the_H_C_Wainwright_28th_436.pdf)


IRVINE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Veritone, Inc.](https://www.veritone.com/) **(NASDAQ: VERI) (“Veritone” or the “Company”),** ** a leader in enterprise AI solutions, today announced Ryan Steelberg, President and Chief Executive Officer will present at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference on Monday, September 14, 2026, at 11:30 a.m. Eastern Time (8:30 a.m. Pacific Time) in New York, NY.


A live webcast of the presentation will be available on the[News & Events section](https://investors.veritone.com/news-events/ir-calendar) of Veritone’s Investor Relations website.


For additional information or to schedule a one-on-one meeting with Veritone management, please contact your H.C. Wainwright representative orinvestors@veritone.com .


**About Veritone**


Veritone (NASDAQ: VERI) is a leader in enterprise artificial intelligence (AI) solutions. Serving organizations in both commercial and regulated sectors, Veritone’s software, services, and industry applications simplify data management, empowering the largest and most recognizable brands in the world to run more efficiently, accelerate decision-making and increase profitability. Veritone’s leading enterprise AI platform, aiWARE™, orchestrates an ever-growing ecosystem of machine learning models to transform audio, video and other data sources into actionable intelligence. By blending human expertise with AI, Veritone advances human potential and drives positive societal change. To learn more, visit[www.veritone.com](http://www.veritone.com/) .
